Title: How will new players get registered?

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
(Now that I got my Prince-ID) I would like to know how new players will get registered. As far as I can see it, the is no thread for it right now or something else. Will new players get their IDs when the results of the tournament were archoned and sent to Damnans?

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
At the moment, this will have to be done manually by me.

So if any prince wants to add a new player to the VEKN Player database, please send me the following information:

1) Player's full name
2) City
3) State/province
4) Country
5) E-mail address
5) VEKN ID# provided by his or her prince (which is the general Prince prefix followed by 4 digits)

Princes can check VEKN ID#'s availability in the  Player Registry

For instance, if you enter your prince prefix to the veknid field in there you'll get all the players whose veknid starts with your prince prefix.

V:EKN Website Coordinator
